articles.title: Delhi School Turns Swimming Pool After Rain, Students Wade Through Classrooms — Who’s Accountable?
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Nigam Pratibha Balika Vidyalaya in Tikri Kalan, Outer Delhi, was flooded after heavy rains, exposing poor infrastructure and raising safety concerns. Viral videos show students standing and sitting on benches in knee-deep water inside classrooms.

body.html:
The Nigam Pratibha Balika Vidyalaya in Tikri Kalan, Outer Delhi, was flooded after heavy rains, exposing poor infrastructure and raising safety concerns. Viral videos show students standing and sitting on benches in knee-deep water inside classrooms.

In another clip, parents are seen carrying their children through the flooded school to keep them dry. The surrounding area also witnessed flood-like conditions.

The IMD has predicted more rain in Delhi-NCR in the coming days, with temperatures between 27°C and 31°C. While the showers brought respite from heat, the incident highlights the capital’s drainage and planning failures.

articles.title: Fake Embassy Busted in Ghaziabad, Harshvardhan Jain’s Shocking Web of Fraud Exposed!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Uttar Pradesh STF has busted an illegal ‘embassy’ running from a rented bungalow in Ghaziabad’s Kavi Nagar and arrested its mastermind, Harshvardhan Jain. Jain posed as an ambassador of fictitious micronations like West Arctica, Saborga, Poulvia, and Lodonia.

body.html:
The Uttar Pradesh STF has busted an illegal ‘embassy’ running from a rented bungalow in Ghaziabad’s Kavi Nagar and arrested its mastermind, Harshvardhan Jain.

Jain posed as an ambassador of fictitious micronations like West Arctica, Saborga, Poulvia, and Lodonia. He used luxury cars with fake diplomatic plates, morphed photos with leaders including PM Modi and ex-President Kalam, and promised jobs and business deals abroad to dupe people.

The STF raid on July 22 recovered ₹44.7 lakh in cash, foreign currency, luxury cars, fake passports, seals, press cards, and forged documents. Jain also had suspected links with Chandraswami and arms dealer Adnan Khashoggi.

A fresh FIR has been lodged at Kavi Nagar police station. The investigation is on to trace his accomplices.

articles.title: Drunk Man Brutally Assaults Woman at Thane Clinic After Being Denied Entry — CCTV Shocks Netizens!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident at a private clinic in Maharashtra’s Thane, a 25-year-old receptionist was allegedly assaulted by an intoxicated man after she denied him entry into a doctor’s chamber without an appointment, police said.

body.html:
In a shocking incident at a private clinic in Maharashtra’s Thane, a 25-year-old receptionist was allegedly assaulted by an intoxicated man after she denied him entry into a doctor’s chamber without an appointment, police said.

The accused, identified as Gokul Jha, reportedly kicked the woman and dragged her by her hair when she stopped him from entering. The doctor was in a meeting at the time and had instructed not to allow anyone inside.

The victim was rescued by hospital staff and patient relatives. The assault was caught on CCTV and has since gone viral, sparking outrage over women’s safety.

An FIR has been registered at Manpada Police Station under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyay Sanhita for assault, obscene language, and outraging a woman’s modesty. The accused is absconding, and a search is underway.

articles.title: Man Tears ₹32,000 Lehenga With Knife Over Refund Dispute, Arrested After CCTV Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was caught on CCTV in a garment showroom in Maharashtra’s Kalyan on Saturday evening, where a man, enraged over a refund dispute, brandished a knife, tore a lehenga and blouse, and threatened the shopkeeper.

body.html:
A shocking incident was caught on CCTV in a garment showroom in Maharashtra’s Kalyan on Saturday evening, where a man, enraged over a refund dispute, brandished a knife, tore a lehenga and blouse, and threatened the shopkeeper.

The accused, identified as Sumit Sayani, was arrested after the video went viral on social media. According to reports, his fiancée had returned a ₹32,000 lehenga, dissatisfied with it, and demanded a refund. When the shopkeeper refused and offered another lehenga instead, Sumit lost his temper, slashed the lehenga and blouse, and allegedly threatened the shopkeeper saying: “I’ll cut you up like this too. Give me back the money!”

The shopkeeper lodged a complaint at Bazaarpeth Police Station, following which police arrested Sumit. No injuries were reported. The aggressive act has left shopkeepers in the area shaken.

articles.title: Lucknow: 3-Year-Old Dies in Private Hospital, Family Alleges Medical Negligence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 3-year-old boy, Jian, from Kesar Bagh, Lucknow, died at a private hospital in Thakurganj allegedly due to doctors’ negligence.

body.html:
A 3-year-old boy, Jian, from Kesar Bagh, Lucknow, died at a private hospital in Thakurganj allegedly due to doctors’ negligence. The child, who suffered from GB syndrome, was admitted to Oxygen Hospital after his health deteriorated following a minor injury while playing five days earlier.

According to the family, on Sunday doctors damaged his lungs while inserting an oxygen pipe, after which his condition worsened and he died in agony. They also alleged they were charged ₹46,000 for an injection after bargaining down from ₹50,000.

The hospital claimed the boy was already critical and died despite best efforts. Deputy CMO A.P. Singh said the matter is serious, and action will be taken after the postmortem and formal complaint.

articles.title: Typhoon Wipha Batters Southern China, 6.7 Lakh Evacuated, Travel Disrupted, Chaos in Hong Kong
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Typhoon Wipha wreaked havoc across southern China on Sunday, forcing nearly 6.7 lakh people to evacuate as it battered Guangdong and Hong Kong with fierce winds and heavy rain.

body.html:
Typhoon Wipha wreaked havoc across southern China on Sunday, forcing nearly 6.7 lakh people to evacuate as it battered Guangdong and Hong Kong with fierce winds and heavy rain.

Videos on social media showed families, children, and commuters struggling to stand as gusts toppled trees and collapsed scaffolding. Over 400 flights were grounded in Hong Kong, affecting 80,000 passengers, and hundreds more flights were delayed in nearby cities. Cathay Pacific suspended flights for much of the day, while ferries and other public transport services were halted.

At least 26 people were injured, over 250 people took refuge in temporary shelters, and more than 470 trees were uprooted in Hong Kong alone.

While less destructive than past storms like Mangkhut and Hato, Wipha caused widespread disruption to daily life and travel, with authorities still assessing the full damage.

articles.title: Lucknow: Man Buys ₹75K Diamond Ring for Wife, Thieves Steal It From Scooty in Minutes
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a daring theft in Lucknow’s Manaknagar, a man and woman stole a ₹75,000 diamond ring from the trunk of a scooty within minutes, after trailing the buyer from a jewellery shop.

body.html:
In a daring theft in Lucknow’s Manaknagar, a man and woman stole a ₹75,000 diamond ring from the trunk of a scooty within minutes, after trailing the buyer from a jewellery shop.

On July 16, around 8:30 PM, Shanu, a resident of LDA Colony, bought the ring for his wife from Kalyan Jewellers near Bargawan Phoenix Mall. He placed the ring, bill, and documents in his Ola electric scooty’s trunk and stopped at a nearby store in Alambagh.

Within 2–3 minutes, CCTV footage showed the duo, who had followed him from the jeweller’s shop, stealing the ring from the scooty and fleeing.

Police have registered a case and are scanning CCTV footage to trace the accused.
